title: A repeated key in a JSON state
notes: A repeated key in a JSON state: both parsers keep the first position and the last value (an agreement the xybrid profile refuses). Upstream keeps the last value at the first position, as Python's json module does; xybrid refuses. Written by tools/conformance/decision_hf/make_cases.py: upstream is left for the upstream oracle to fill, and the xybrid expectations are proposals.
